scope: design-oriented survey; source links and limited claims, not an exhaustive bibliography

sources.title: Manchester Illuminated Universal Turing Machines
sources.claim_used: Artist account of plotter illumination of machine code.
sources.limit: A precedent for the practice, not evidence of a historical occult lineage.

sources.title: Art, Logic, and the Decision Problem
sources.claim_used: Artist books, parent-code variants, plotter production and Alice Wagstaff contribution.
sources.limit: Do not inherit a priority claim from curatorial promotional language.

sources.title: Anything but Simple: Gift Drawings and the Shaker Aesthetic
sources.institution: American Folk Art Museum / Hancock Shaker Village
sources.claim_used: Named Shaker gift-drawing makers and spiritual-gift context.
sources.limit: Spiritual message does not establish a cipher or a recovered plaintext.

sources.title: Pennsylvania German fraktur, broadsides, and related drawings, LOT 12683
sources.claim_used: Mixed certificate, writing-exercise, blessing and heaven-letter collection.
sources.limit: The collection does not make all fraktur magical.

sources.title: A Letter from God / Ein Brief von Gott, frk01084
sources.claim_used: The document instructs copying/disclosure and asserts protection.
sources.limit: The assertions belong to the historical document; efficacy is not established.

sources.title: Written Mnemonics - Deciphering a Controversial Ritual
sources.claim_used: Distinguishes mnemonic prompts from keyed encryption in the 1860 Morris publication.
sources.limit: This survey does not reconstruct that historical key or equate all ritual books.

sources.title: Masonic Ritual Cipher: A Personal Object
sources.claim_used: A cipher book can also preserve personal participation and ownership history.
sources.limit: Provenance/participation is separate from what the owner believed.

sources.title: Factory History / Museum collection
sources.claim_used: Fraternal initiation apparatus and related manufacturing.
sources.limit: Do not assign every device to Freemasonry; no construction plans are inferred.

sources.title: Charles Dellschau / collection label booklet
sources.institution: American Visionary Art Museum; American Folk Art Museum
sources.claim_used: Notebook airships, collage and the artist account of a Sonora Aero Club.
sources.limit: The account does not independently establish a real club or working anti-gravity technology.

sources.title: The Book of the 7 Dispensation / Hampton writings
sources.institution: Smithsonian American Art Museum; Archives of American Art
sources.source_type: object record, curatorial account and archival finding aid
sources.claim_used: A devotional ledger and writings in an unfamiliar script.
sources.limit: No decoding key supplied by the inspected evidence; no inference of meaningless writing.

sources.title: Untitled, individual element from the Healing Machine
sources.claim_used: Material assemblage associated with Blagdon and his stated purpose.
sources.limit: The healing purpose is attributed, not verified therapy.

sources.title: Punch Cards / John LaTourette double-cloth coverlet, 1844
sources.source_type: technical collection and textile object record
sources.claim_used: Punched-card control and an American Jacquard textile.
sources.limit: Programmed ornament is not automatically an encrypted message.

sources.title: Interpreting Sanborn Maps
sources.claim_used: Purpose-built codes, edition-specific keys and paste-on corrections.
sources.limit: Check each edition key; our invented parcels are not historical map data.
